per_object_cap.notes: Up to 1 TB per file on every plan, including Free; there is no per-file fee, only the total storage quota.

retention.stated: Anonymous downloads expire 7 hours after link generation; temp files auto-delete at 7 days.
retention.notes: Toggle Temporary before you upload and the file is automatically deleted 7 days later; it does not count against permanent storage.

egress.terms: All plans include unlimited file size, unlimited bandwidth, and every platform feature.

record.tooling: Supports rclone via WebDAV (`https://patrins.com/dav`). Features REST API and tus 1.0 resumable uploads, webhooks, command-line interface, Telegram integration, and WebDAV drive mapping.
record.chaining: 8 GB permanent storage with 1 TB max file size; rclone mount patrins: /mnt/patrins.
record.limits_note: Free 8 GB storage, unlimited file size, unlimited bandwidth. Rate limits: public upload init 500/hour (files <1 GB) and 30/hour (>=1 GB) per IP; chunks 500/hour; finalize 30/hour; bulk zip 10/hour per user. Anonymous downloads expire 7 hours after link generation; temp files auto-delete at 7 days.
record.reliability_note: Per-file cap without matching storage is the classic trap: 1 TB/file x 8 GB total means the big-file capability is unusable without paying. API init returns 401 'Authentication required' without a bearer token, so 'no account needed' only holds for the temp flow.
record.confidence_note: All plans include unlimited file size, unlimited bandwidth, and every platform feature.
